material_definitions: In order to better understand the effect of aliovalent doping in Li+ conducting argyrodites, the substitution of P5+ with Si4+ was performed in the solid solutions Li(6+x)P(1-x)SixS5X.
warnings: Raw conductivity was cited as 'greater than 2 mS cm-1'. Only the numeric boundary '2' was extracted.
Temperature is inferred as room temperature (25 C), common convention for maximal conductivity reports unless specified otherwise.
Composition is a solid solution series (Li(6+x)P(1-x)SixS5X), not a specific endpoint or single material.

material_definitions: Solid solutions Li(6+x)P(1-x)SixS5Br argyrodite superionics were investigated.
Ionic conductivity measurements were performed using temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy.
The substitution of P4+ by Si4+ leads to an increase in Li+ content.
The highest conductivity was achieved for x = 0.35.

warnings: Temperature is stated as 'Room temperature' and normalized to 25 C.
